parsed_response.explanation: The agent misinterpreted the core meaning of the problem statement, specifically the phrase 'reduced by one-quarter'. It incorrectly assumed this meant 'reduced to one-quarter' (i.e., 25% remaining) instead of 'reduced by 25%' (i.e., 75% remaining). This fundamental misunderstanding led to an incorrect setup of the decay equation and consequently a wrong final answer.
